name: application-alerts
title: Alerts
description: Inline alert and banner components for status messages, dismissible notices, warnings with actions, and left-accent notification variants.
useWhen: Surfacing a status message, warning, or confirmation inline within page content rather than as a transient toast.
Communicating an error or validation problem that should persist until the user acts on it.
Grouping several related status messages (success, warning, error) in a stacked layout.
avoidWhen: The message is transient and should disappear automatically — use a toast instead.
You need a blocking confirmation before a destructive action — use an alert dialog instead.
responsiveBehavior: Alerts are a single-column flex layout that wraps text naturally; the max-w-lg container in the example can be removed to fill any parent width.
accessibility: Informational alerts use role="status"; alerts requiring immediate attention (errors, failures) use role="alert" so screen readers announce them without user action.
Icons are decorative and marked aria-hidden — meaning is conveyed by text, not color or icon shape alone.
Dismiss buttons carry an aria-label since they contain only an icon.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Simple informational alert with icon, title, and message
accessibility: Uses role="status" for a non-urgent informational message.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Simple informational alert with icon, title, and message
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Stacked severities
variants.description: Success, warning, and error alerts stacked to show the full semantic color range
accessibility: The error alert uses role="alert" so it interrupts screen reader flow; success and warning use role="status".

variants.title: Stacked severities (Dark)
variants.description: Success, warning, and error alerts stacked to show the full semantic color range
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: With actions
variants.description: Warning alert with a title, message, and primary/secondary action buttons
accessibility: Uses role="alert" since it requires user action before storage fills up.

variants.title: With actions (Dark)
variants.description: Warning alert with a title, message, and primary/secondary action buttons
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces, including button states.

variants.title: Left accent
variants.description: Minimal alerts with a colored left border instead of a filled background, for lower-emphasis notices
accessibility: The connection-lost alert uses role="alert"; the maintenance notice uses role="status".

variants.title: Left accent (Dark)
variants.description: Minimal alerts with a colored left border instead of a filled background, for lower-emphasis notices
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Dismissible
variants.description: Informational alert with a close button for user dismissal
accessibility: The dismiss button has an aria-label since it is icon-only.

variants.title: Dismissible (Dark)
variants.description: Informational alert with a close button for user dismissal
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
